access.metaTitle: Remote access to a home server behind CGNAT - Syncloud
access.title: Your server runs, but you cannot reach it from outside
access.subtitle: Behind CGNAT, DS-Lite or a changing IP there is no port to forward. Syncloud reaches your server through a relay instead.
points: Reachable with no port forwarding, even behind CGNAT
An address like yourname.syncloud.it that follows your IP when it changes
An HTTPS certificate, issued and renewed for you
An alternative to Tailscale, ZeroTier or a Cloudflare tunnel, with the domain, the certificate and the relay included
Outgoing mail through a relay, so your apps are not treated as spam
